summary: The message being replied to could not be resolved.

match_any.description_exact: Bad Request: message to be replied not found

possible_causes: The bot cannot access the referenced message.
A reply-message lookup failed and its original error was replaced.
diagnostic_limits: The response does not prove that the message was deleted. Reply settings and the referenced chat also affect this lookup.

evidence.note: Reply lookup uses this fallback for unavailable access or a failed required-message lookup.
allow_sending_without_reply can permit an empty result instead of failing.
The fallback replaces only errors normalized to code 400.
Adds the code-specific prefix and lowercases only the initial character of ordinary messages.

response.description: Bad Request: message to be replied not found

preconditions: Verify the reply message and chat; omit the reply only if the application permits sending without it.
